description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableFeatureDefinitionIdentifier' that implements the 'DefinitionIdentifier' interface. It provides factory methods for creating instances from explicit parameters or parsed strings, and overrides methods for equality, hashing, string representation, and delegation to an internal 'delegate' object.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureDefinitionIdentifier
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the 'DefinitionIdentifier' interface, providing methods for creation, equality, and string representation, all delegating to an internal 'delegate' object.

methods.name: ofParsed

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace part of the identifier.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name part of the identifier.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version part of the identifier.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the delegate's equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the delegate.

methods.description: Returns the length of the delegate.
